subscription.name: Subscription
subscription.description: Customers pay a recurring fee (monthly or annually) for continued access to your product or service. Predictable MRR makes forecasting and fundraising easier.

freemium.name: Freemium
freemium.description: A free tier drives user acquisition; a paid tier unlocks advanced features. Requires a compelling upgrade trigger and low marginal cost per free user.

usage.name: Usage-Based
usage.description: Customers pay in proportion to what they consume — API calls, data processed, seats, or transactions. Revenue scales naturally with customer growth.

transactional.name: Transactional
transactional.description: Revenue is earned each time a discrete transaction or sale occurs, with no ongoing commitment. Works well for high-frequency or high-value single purchases.

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.description: A platform connects buyers and sellers; you take a percentage of each transaction (take rate). Network effects are the moat — both sides must be acquired.
